svg.title: From an issue to a merged PR
svg.desc: One real request through the harness. You write issue #8 with /harness. In the daemon a code filter with no model keeps it, the SQLite event log records it, and the router (Claude Code on Opus, harness MCP tools only) opens a ticket and replies. In Atomic the worker (Sol with pstack, in its own git worktree) commits and never pushes; a follow-up comment reaches it in about 3 seconds without the router; its questions go back to the issue. A fresh Opus verifier runs the tests, and an edit voids its verdict; a FAIL starts a new attempt. The bot opens PR #9 with the verdict and Closes #8. You merge; the harness never merges.
